correctness.rationale: Orient the update normals to have inner product c>0 and write a=uᵀx, b=vᵀx and k=ω(2−ω). The mixed order u then v loses k[a²+(b−ωca)²] from the squared norm; the repeated u draw loses k[1+(1−ω)²]a². The analogous losses with u and v exchanged give, after averaging, E_iid−E_rr=(kω/4){[2−ω(1−c²)](a²+b²)−4cab}. In the orthonormal normalized sum and difference directions this gives the two advertised factors. The common perpendicular contributes zero. The minus factor is positive on the stipulated open domain, and the plus factor vanishes only at 2/(1+c), with the stated sign change. In the path graph, the two-dimensional span is precisely the disagreement plane, c=1/2, and the bisectors have the stated coordinates. Independent check at ω=3/2: the mixed risks are 103/256 and 61/256; the repeated-order averages are 19/64 and 49/64, giving the printed IID risks after averaging with the mixed risks.
residual_risks: No uploaded code was executed. The exact classification is conditional on the deterministic start and concerns only two steps, not multiple epochs.

evidence: 1370f23f939c prints the two factors [2−ω(1±c)] with the identical common prefactor for the objective-gap modes. fb917dbc8054 independently prints the identical two Euclidean comparison eigenvalues for two-row Kaczmarz, under the same ranges and sampling laws.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Take H=[[1,c],[c,1]] and set z=H^(1/2)(x−x*). The two coordinate maps become I−ωq_i q_iᵀ with q_i=H^(1/2)e_i; q_i are unit with Gram matrix H. The objective gap is ||z||²/2 and its modal parts are half of the corresponding squared Euclidean components; the factors thus agree exactly after multiplying both risks by two. Any oriented pair u,v with inner product c has this same Gram matrix, so an isometry sends q_1,q_2 to u,v and sends their bisectors to the target bisectors.

value.rationale: The angular frontier itself is a meaningful structural fact, but its content is already supplied in isometric form. What the frozen record adds is a graph interpretation with fixed c=1/2 and a rational illustration; the exact cutoff, directions and comparison require no new graph argument beyond that substitution. The record does not establish a distinct useful mathematical invariant, boundary or classification beyond the covered comparison.
